data: Which of the following takes less than 10 seconds on New York Times at 1000 docs?

The question asks which of the three methods (CorEx, Sparse CorEx, or LDA) takes less than 10 seconds on New York Times at 1000 documents. From the caption, we know that the data is for New York Times articles. 

Looking at the third row of graphs, which corresponds to New York Times, we can see the time taken by each method as the number of documents increases. At approximately 1000 documents, all three methods take more than 10 seconds. However, we need to determine which one takes less than 10 seconds.

By examining the graph, it appears that LDA takes less than 10 seconds at 1000 documents, while CorEx and Sparse CorEx take more than 10 seconds. Therefore, the answer is LDA.
